title: Alibaba Cloud Unveils Agent-Native Innovations at WAIC
event_hint: Alibaba Cloud announced an Agent-Native Cloud suite (AgentRun, AgentLoop, AgentTeams), TokenWorks PaaS inference platform, T-Head SAIL open-source stack, and wearable AI devices at WAIC 2026.
problem: Enterprises need managed, governed environments to build, deploy and operate autonomous AI agents and to run large-model inference efficiently at scale.
mechanism: Alibaba Cloud positions a full-stack AI ecosystem spanning chip, infrastructure, platform and application layers, moving from AI-native to Agent-native architecture. At the platform layer, PAI TokenWorks (used via PAI-EAS / Elastic AI Service) integrates request routing, inference execution, compute reuse and scheduling into a unified system to improve inference performance, cost and reliability. The Agent-Native Cloud suite manages, optimizes and orchestrates multi-agent workflows across the lifecycle.

evidence.claim: Alibaba Cloud launched an Agent-Native Cloud suite consisting of AgentRun, AgentLoop and AgentTeams to support the full lifecycle of enterprise-grade AI agents with built-in governance.
evidence.source_locator: Evidence locator: 云基础设施：从 AI 原生到 Agent 原生

evidence.claim: PAI TokenWorks, available through PAI-EAS (Elastic AI Service), integrates request routing, inference execution, compute reuse and scheduling into a unified system to improve LLM inference performance, cost and reliability.
evidence.source_locator: Evidence locator: 云基础设施：从 AI 原生到 Agent 原生

evidence.claim: T-Head (Pingtouge) open-sourced its AI software stack SAIL, covering OS layer, SDK layer and interface layer, built for the Zhenwu (真武) series AI chips; as of April 2026 Zhenwu cumulative shipments reached 560,000 chips serving 400+ customers across 20+ industries.
evidence.source_locator: Evidence locator: 开源人工智能基础设施

evidence.claim: Alibaba released Qwen 3.8-Max-Preview with 2.4 trillion parameters on July 19 via Token Plan, Qoder and QoderWork; initial testing ranked it second only to Fable 5; Qwen 3.8-Max open weights were announced as forthcoming.
evidence.baseline: Fable 5 (ranked above it in initial testing)
evidence.source_locator: Evidence locator: 阿里云在WAIC上发布智能体原生创新成果

evidence.claim: Miaowu (秒悟) AI dev tool launched a team edition with unified billing, quota allocation, team management and asset sharing; off-peak pricing can cut token cost to 20% of the standard price during designated periods.
evidence.source_locator: Evidence locator: AI 开发工具秒悟推出团队版

evaluation_context: Vendor announcement from WAIC 2026 (Alibaba Group primary source). No TTFT, TPOT, token throughput, KVCache transfer volume, network utilization, or end-to-end P95 metrics are exposed. No workload scale, hardware platform, or independent benchmark accompanies the inference-platform claims.
limitations: The visible Evidence Pack does not describe TPN (Token Performance Network) network-layer mechanisms, KVCache-aware scheduling, or any quantitative TTFT/TPOT/network metrics despite the source being routed to the TPN topic. The discovery summary's claim that Alibaba Cloud 'introduced TPN at the network layer' within this full-stack refresh is not supported by the visible evidence text and was not recorded as fact. Qwen 3.8-Max-Preview comparison to Fable 5 is based on unspecified 'initial tests', not a disclosed benchmark suite.
project_relevance: TokenWorks' unified routing/scheduling and the Agent-Native suite are relevant to inference-serving efficiency, but the visible evidence does not confirm a network-side, KVCache-aware mechanism that would qualify as TPN per the project card. Network-layer specifics (state-aware scheduling, cross-node KVCache transfer reduction) would be needed to assess TPN relevance.
source_notes: Source is an Alibaba Group official announcement (vendor primary) fetched as FETCHED; content is product-launch narrative, not measured systems results.
The source was routed to TPN topic/direction but the visible Evidence Pack contains no TPN-specific network mechanism or quantitative Token performance metrics.

evidence_gaps.question: Does the source describe TPN (Token Performance Network) network-layer mechanisms, KVCache-aware scheduling, or cross-node bandwidth scheduling, and with what quantitative TTFT/TPOT/network utilization results?
